<?php

$baseUrl = 'https://api.spryng.nl/v2/contacts/bulk';
$ch = curl_init();
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $baseUrl);

$headers = [
     'X-Api-Key' => 'YOUR_KEY_HERE'
    ];

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);


    $body = json_encode([
  "accountReference" => "SPNLxxxxxx",
  "contacts" => [
    [
      "firstName" => "firstName",
      "lastName" => "lastName",
      "quickName" => "quickName",
      "addresses" => [
        [
          "addressType" => "addressType",
          "addressValue" => "addressValue",
          "optOutStatus" => "optOutStatus"
        ]
      ],
      "contactMetadata" => new stdClass(),
      "groups" => [
        ""
      ]
    ]
  ]
]);
        
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);

$response = curl_exec($ch);

curl_close($ch);

if ($info['http_code'] >= 400) {
    echo 'Error! HTTP code: ' . $info['http_code'] . ', Response: ' . $response;
} else {
    echo 'Success! Response: ' . $response;
}

sections.title: API overview
sections.content:
This endpoint allows you to add a list of new contacts in bulk with a single API request.

Note: Existing contact records will not be updated when using this endpoint. To add and update existing records in the same call, please refer to the the Bulk update/create endpoint documentation.

The documentation in this section contains the core reference information you will need to create contacts via our API, including required headers, cURL sample & error codes.

Before you start using this endpoint, please check you have your Account, API Key and Base URL set up and have familiarised yourself with our implementation prerequisites.

sections.title: Headers
sections.content:
These parameters are mandatory to be provided in the header of your request. If not provided, or incorrect, your request will fail.

HeaderTypeDescription
Content-TypeStringapplication/json
X-Api-KeyStringAPI Key value for authorization

Example request header:
POST https://api.spryng.nl/v2/contacts/bulk
-H 'Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'
-H 'Content-Type: application/json'

sections.title: Request body
sections.content:
If a required parameter is not provided, or incorrect, the request will fail. If a parameter is conditional, it is only required for certain channels or is dependent on the desired format of the message.

ParameterTypeRequired or ConditionalDescription
accountReferenceStringRequiredYour Spryng account reference - e.g. SPNL0000000
contacts.firstNameStringRequiredThe first name of the contact. Max length 500 characters
contacts.lastNameStringRequiredThe last name of the contact. Max length 500 characters
contacts.addressTypeJSON objectConditionalThe type of address to be stored e.g. MSISDN | Email
contacts.addressValueJSON valueConditionalThe email address or mobile number to be stored

Optional request body parameters

These parameters are not mandatory within the request body, they are designed to provide you further capability to customise or filter your requests.

ParameterTypeDescription
contacts.quickNameStringThe short name of the contact
contacts.optOutStatusJSON ValueA binary value to determine if the user is opted out of marketing communications. Accepted values Subscribedor unsubscribed
contacts.contactMetadataObjectProvided as an object e.g. “team” : “your data added here”. These are saved with the message and will be returned when exporting the message history. This can make some data analysis easier
contacts.groupsJSON arrayCan be used to add the contact to group(s). If using this parameter a valid groupID must be provided

Example Request body
{
    "accountReference": "SPNL0000000",
    "contacts": [
        {
            "firstName": "Joe",
            "lastName": "Blogs",
            "quickName": "Blogs1",
            "addresses": [
                {
                    "addressType": "Msisdn",
                    "addressValue": "+447711000039"
                }
            ],
            "contactMetadata": {
                "team": "octopus"
            },
            "groups": [
                "a56cd83a-f58f-4f07-be76-164c2d734787"
            ]
        },
        {
            "firstName": "Jon",
            "lastName": "Blogs",
            "quickName": "Blogs02",
            "addresses": [
                {
                    "addressType": "Msisdn",
                    "addressValue": "+447711000031",
                    "optOutStatus": "Subscribed"
                }
            ],
            "contactMetadata": {
                "team": "octopus"
            },
            "groups": [
                "a56cd83a-f58f-4f07-be76-164c2d734787"
            ]
        }
    ]
}

sections.title: Responses
sections.content:

Error codes
400 Bad Request
The server couldn't process the request due to one or more of the required fields being invalid or missing.

Response example
{ 
    "errors": [
        {
            "errorCode": "error code",
            "errorMessage": "error message"
        }
    ]
}

401 Unauthorized
The server couldn't process the request as the authentication was missing or invalid.

Response example
{
    "title": "An error occurred while processing the request",
    "status": 401,
    "message": "Request for authenticated route '/v2/contacts/bulk' was unauthenticated",
    "errors": {},

            "metadata": {
                "unauthenticatedError": "Request for authenticated route '/v2/contacts/bulk' was unauthenticated"
            }
        }
    ]
}
